pamphlet_excerpts: Citizenship in The Community Means: Public policy includes the goals the government sets as well as theactions required to achieve those goals (p. 10).
Citizenship in The Community Means Principle 2: Some citizens do notvote, voluntarily giving up their voice in the government (p. 10).

Citizenship in The Community Means Principle 3: Other citizens do not know or care about what is going on in their community, until a prison is built in their neighborhood, orthe crime rate grows (p. 10).
Citizenship in The Community Means Principle 4: Unless they are upset about a particularissue, most citizens leave the decisions to elected representatives and local activists (p. 10).
step_by_step_procedure: Step 1 (Citizenship in The Community Means): People who feel connected to their community tend toparticipate (p. 10).
Step 2 (Citizenship in The Community Means): The more active citizens are in their community, withties to a school, youth groups, businesses, and service clubs, the more interest they (p. 10).
Step 3 (Citizenship in The Community Means): Thatis why longtime residents often hold local offices (p. 10).
Step 4 (Citizenship in The Community Means): You have a chance now to build connections in your own community (p. 10).
